Name: Pretty Anime PolyamorySweet Portraits
Author: SerDakota
Description:
This mod simply replaces the portraits of Lantana from PolyamorySweet with portraits done in an anime style. With permission from ApryllForever I have also included her winter sprite and winter portraits so in base PolyamorySweet she now changes for winter.

This mod is compatable with Marry Lantana with some slight json edits.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Shop Portrait Overall is Optional but without it you will NOT get the enlarged shop portrait, nor any shop portrait at all. So its HIGHLY recommended you use it. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Pretty Anime Portraits is also optional but highly recommended if youd like to have a consistent style across portraits.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]GMCM if youd like to change what shop portrait is shown when using Shop Portrait overhaul.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Credit:[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Credit to ApryllForever for creating PolyamorySweet and the character Lantana. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]These portraits are Ai generated with manual editing by me when needed.[/color]
